beats.label: S1 · The Siegel case
beats.text: PI John Sugar takes the case of missing Olivia Siegel, granddaughter of legendary producer Jonathan, despite his handler Ruby warning him to stay away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the case, Sugar's protagonist role, and the first hint that his own people don't want him on it.

beats.label: S1 · A body and a cover-up
beats.text: Sugar finds Clifford Carter dead in Olivia's car and learns from Melanie that Olivia killed him in self-defense after finding him with Carmen's body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes Olivia from addict-runaway to fugitive, and pulls Melanie in as Sugar's only real ally.

beats.label: S1 · David's rot
beats.text: Sugar uncovers that Jonathan's grandson David has been sexually blackmailing women using girls supplied by gangster Byron Stallings; exposed publicly, David shoots himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Siegel-family thread and points the case squarely at Stallings and whoever he's protecting.

beats.label: S1 · Sugar is not human
beats.text: Ambushed at Stallings' house, Sugar deflects a bullet with his hand and kills two men before executing Stallings. Alone, he injects himself and briefly reveals a blue-skinned form.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's central secret lands: Sugar and his 'polyglot' circle are aliens observing humans.

beats.label: S1 · Ruby betrays him
beats.text: Sugar realises Ruby tipped Stallings off. Confronted, she won't explain, only insisting he drop the case; the polyglot mission is being recalled home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits Sugar from his own people and sets him against Ruby for the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Henry the accomplice
beats.text: Sugar finds Olivia caged in a senator's son's basement and returns her alive. Listening to the killer's tapes, he realises his oldest friend Henry was the second man in the room.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the resolved kidnapping into a new hunt and names the antagonist Sugar will chase next.

beats.label: S1 · Staying behind
beats.text: Henry taunts Sugar with clothes belonging to his long-lost sister Djen. Ruby admits the polyglots knew of the experiments but not of Djen; Sugar refuses extraction to hunt Henry.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every open thread for the next season funnels through this choice: Sugar stranded on Earth, hunting his own kind.

cliffhanger.text: Sugar has stayed behind on Earth as his people depart, hunting Henry — a fellow polyglot who abetted a serial killer for research and who may know what happened to Sugar's missing sister Djen.
questions: Where has Henry gone, and what does he actually know about Djen?
What happens to Sugar now that he's cut off from Ruby and the mission's support?
Will Melanie, now aware Sugar isn't human, stay in his life?

characters.name: John Sugar
characters.line: LA private eye and cinephile who is secretly a blue-skinned alien observer; stayed on Earth to hunt Henry and find his sister.

characters.name: Henry
characters.line: Sugar's oldest friend and fellow polyglot, revealed as the accomplice to a senator's-son serial killer; on the run and taunting Sugar with clues about Djen.

characters.name: Ruby
characters.line: Sugar's handler and the polyglot mission's leader; tipped off Stallings to protect the group from human blackmailers and now considers the mission over.

characters.name: Olivia Siegel
characters.line: Jonathan's granddaughter, recovered alive from the killer's basement; secretly Jonathan's biological daughter, not Bernie's.

characters.name: Melanie Matthews
characters.line: Olivia's former stepmother and Sugar's confidante; knows Sugar is not human after he briefly showed her his true form.

characters.name: Jonathan Siegel
characters.line: The aging producer who hired Sugar; recovered from his heart attack and has confirmed Olivia is his biological daughter.

characters.name: Bernie Siegel
characters.line: Olivia's presumed father and David's father; belatedly frightened for Olivia and now grieving David.

characters.name: Djen
characters.line: Sugar's long-missing sister, whose clothes Henry left behind as bait — proof someone on Earth knows what happened to her.
